verdict.rationale: Twilio's own docs describe an SDK/API for integrating Authy (authy-docs-1, authy-docs-13), but a direct probe of the same page shows the Authy API is deprecated and 'closed to new customers' with 'no programmatic surface remains open to new integrations' (authy-probe-rt-1), meaning an AI-native user cannot actually drive Authy via a documented public API today. Missing for 10: an open, actively maintained public API for new integrations, migration path documentation usable by AI agents, and independent confirmation of working programmatic access.
